definition: to heat food in a microwave oven
description: In an anime kitchen at night, a green-haired boy puts a bowl of noodles into a microwave, starts it and watches the bowl spin and steam; he pulls the hot bowl out with an "ow, hot, hot!", puts on oven mitts, and a girl points at the microwave asking for hers next.
transcript: Ow! Hot, hot! My next please.
